title: Warehouse row filters must resolve columns under `properties` at compile time
answers: Workflow triggered from a warehouse table never fires when I add a column filter
Real-time filters cannot read <column> on data warehouse trigger
Warehouse SQL expression filter with bare column name fails to compile
Why does record.column work in a warehouse filter
body:
Warehouse rows reach the HogVM filter under `properties` (no person, one invocation per row), so column reads must compile to `properties.<col>`.
- Picker filters: `_as_row_properties` in posthog/cdp/filters.py rewrites `type: data_warehouse` props to `event` type, applied in `_build_global_property_filters` and `_build_warehouse_table_filters`.
- SQL (hogql) filters: `compile_filters_bytecode` recompiles via `_resolve_warehouse_columns` and `_WarehouseRowFields` (bare unknown root or `record.x` becomes `properties.x`) only when `filters.source` is in `DATA_WAREHOUSE_SOURCES`.
- Locals (lambda args, `let`, recursive lambda names) shadow columns. Real globals (`timestamp`, `event`) are never moved, so such columns must be written `record.x` or `properties.x`.
- The team's test account filters are NOT rewritten and stay under the unknown-global guard. Event-source filters with unknown names must still be refused.
Bytecode is compiled at save time, so existing saved filters need a re-save to pick up changes.
applies: posthog/cdp/filters.py filter compilation for data-warehouse-table / data-warehouse-view sources (workflow triggers and destinations)
